scope: Independent static review; not RP2040 execution or electrical validation
reviewed: Amplifier enable initializes low before peripheral initialization.
Sensor stays in XSHUT until USB configured or explicitly armed dedicated-adapter mode. Host presence latches mute until power cycle.
VL53L1X AVDD I2C and GPIO modes explicitly set/read back; bounded driver and I2C waits; transport errors fail quiet.
Only changed burst-coherent stream counter refreshes frame freshness; independent frozen-frame test passes.
USB suspend and post-start deconfiguration disable amplifier, assert XSHUT, clear note, request audio stop; LED is off while power mode is unavailable.
Audio stop masks interrupts, aborts DMA, disables I2S, acknowledges DMA IRQ, publishes stopped state, then parks until power cycle. Watchdog allows parked state.
Underrun telemetry counts the actual empty consumer-buffer branch, not producer time gaps.
Two silent audio buffers precede DMA enable; hardware switch directly disables amplifier independently of firmware.
corrected_findings: Frozen sensor frame previously refreshed freshness indefinitely.
Status LED previously blinked as a sensor fault before power readiness and during suspend.
USB deconfiguration previously did not shut down already-started peripherals.
pending: Physical I/O startup and I2C signaling.
RP2040 PIO/I2S waveform, audio starvation and analog output tests.

limitations: Shutdown reduces peripheral load; it does not establish the USB suspend current limit at a 120 MHz MCU clock.
After suspend/deconfiguration, the audio core remains parked until a power cycle by design.
